name: ShuttleBorder
description: A point of light that runs around the edge of whatever is inside, like the shuttle of a loom crossing the threads. Wrap a card, an input or a button; give it your radius and background.

children.description: The content the light runs around.

color.description: Colour of the light, any CSS colour. Defaults to the action colour.

borderWidth.description: Thickness of the light in pixels.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

className.description: Classes for the wrapper: set its radius, background and border here.

requirements: Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and the effect can also be shown still with the rdm-still class
The light is drawn in a layer that ignores the pointer, so it never blocks clicks or text selection
The content inside is unchanged: its own contrast and focus apply
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code
screenReader: Silent: the wrapper adds nothing to what is read

use_when: Highlighting one card, pricing plan or search field
Drawing the eye to a featured block
avoid_when: Content that someone must read for a long time right next to the moving light
anti_patterns: Putting it on every card in a grid
